# 25 — View counts and named readers: blind adversarial QA

**Verdict: FAIL** (2 major defects; every AC except the library-column and tablet-panel behaviour passes).
Tested blind (no diff, no src/ for #25) on 2026-10-10 against worktree md-review-cap-social-qa25 (#21+#24+#25 uncommitted).
Drivers and logs: `.verify/qa/25/{server-qa.mjs,browser-qa.mjs,pin-qa.mjs}`, `server-log.txt`, `browser-log.txt`, screenshots `.verify/qa/25/*.png`.
Server checks used own backends (fresh DATA_DIR, `MDREVIEW_NOW` restarts across the day boundary) plus `mcp-server-http.js` with temp `MCP_TOKEN_STORE`; browser checks via `scripts/lib/browser-slot.sh scripts/lib/stack.sh run -- node …`.

## AC verdicts
- AC-25.1 PASS — 3 POSTs same reader/day → `{total_views:1, unique_readers:1}`; POST returns 204.
- AC-25.2 PASS — POST at 23:59:59Z then (restart) 00:00:01Z → two rows (days 2026-10-10/11), total 2, unique 1.
- AC-25.3 PASS — Ana×2 browsers + "ana" + anon: one entry `views:3`, `anonymous_readers:1`; no token → exactly 3 keys; Bearer and X-Edit-Token both work; wrong token → aggregates only (200).
- AC-25.4 PASS — after PUT, Ana `is_current:false`, `revision` = A.
- AC-25.5 PASS — view with valid token leaves counts unchanged; editor name absent from `readers`. (Wrong token → stored as normal reader, 204 — acceptable.)
- AC-25.6 PASS — legacy doc (hash NULLed) returns `readers` + `anonymous_readers` without a token.
- AC-25.7 PASS — bad/short/65-char/numeric/missing reader_id → 400 `invalid_reader`; `xyz`, 31/33 hex, uppercase hex → 400 `invalid_revision`; malformed JSON 400; unknown 404 (POST+GET); expired 410 (POST+GET).
- AC-25.8 PASS — exactly 1 POST after 3.5 s, `revision` = content_hash, reader_id `anon-<uuid>`; reload → total stays 1.
- AC-25.9 PASS — navigate away after 1 s → 0 POSTs. Hidden tab: 0 POSTs while hidden, none 1.2 s after becoming visible, 1 after ≥2 s.
- AC-25.10 PASS — `?embed=1` and `?filePath=tests/e2e/fixture.md` and landing → 0 POSTs; no `view-stats` in embed.
- AC-25.11 PASS — editor (`?edit=`) panel: 2 `reader-row`s, one `reader-latest-badge`, one `reader-stale-badge` title `a932038` (short hash), time title ISO, footer "+ 1 anonymous" (desktop-editor-panel.png).
- AC-25.12 PASS — viewer: `<span>` "4 views · 4 readers", tabIndex -1, click opens nothing.
- AC-25.13 PASS — Slackbot `/d/<id>`, Twitterbot `/d/<id>@<hash>`, `/d/<id>.md`, `GET /paste`, MCP `get_session`/`get_views` → 0 rows.
- AC-25.14 PASS — MCP `create_session`, then new connection `get_views` without token → `readers` present (token store); foreign protected doc → aggregates only; explicit token → readers; `list_sessions` keys unchanged; stdio server exposes `get_views`.

## Other checks (pass)
Live-sync revision change → a 2nd POST with the new hash; pinned `/d/<id>@<hash>` → POST with the pinned hash (pinned-fresh.png); two tabs → 1 row; name set later the same day → same row gains name, anonymous 1→0; empty/whitespace name keeps prior name; "  Ana  " groups with "Ana", "ÉLODIE"/"élodie" grouped (latest spelling); HTML in names renders as text; empty state "No named readers yet" + anon footer; 0 views → hidden (editor's own view keeps it hidden); slug delete+reuse → rows cascade, counts 0; 5 000 rows: GET 29 ms anon / 87 ms editor (first call; 58 ms warm) — under 100 ms but close; no IP/UA columns; editor (edit view) header has no `view-stats`; keyboard: Tab reaches trigger, Enter/Space open, Esc closes and returns focus, click-outside closes; phone panel is a full-width bottom sheet, no horizontal scroll, long/RTL/CJK names ellipsised (phone-long-names.png); `view-stats` in `doc-meta-row` below 1100 px and after `doc-updated` at ≥1100 px; 6 themes render header text in the muted meta token (theme-*.png); no page errors.

## Defects
1. **MAJOR — `GET /library/docs` `view_count` (and `sort=views`) counts editor views.** Repro: create protected doc, POST views from 2 readers, POST one view with its valid `X-Edit-Token`. `GET /paste/:id/views` → `total_views:2`; `GET /library/docs` → `view_count:3`. Contradicts the decision "editors' own views are excluded" and makes the library number disagree with the header. Evidence: server-log.txt "FAIL library view_count excludes editor (d4=2): 3".
2. **MAJOR — readers panel is cut off at tablet widths (641–1099 px).** The panel is anchored so its left edge is at x = −93 px (820, 641 and 1099 px wide; trigger at x 127 in `doc-meta-row`). Panel title and reader names are off-screen; only the time and badge remain visible. No horizontal scroll appears, so it can't be recovered. Desktop (x 166) and phone (full-width sheet) are fine. Screenshots: panel-820.png, panel-641.png, panel-1099.png, tablet-editor-panel.png.
3. MINOR — `name` of a non-string type (`{a:1}`) is accepted with 204 (silently ignored/coerced), not 400; 2 MB request body accepted on `POST /views` (no small body cap on a public, unauthenticated endpoint).
4. MINOR — MCP `get_views` with an explicit *wrong* `editToken` silently returns aggregates rather than the #23 "edit-protected" error; the agent cannot tell its token is bad.
5. COSMETIC — dark/default header text `rgb(110,106,101)` on the dark header is about 3.2:1 for 12 px text (same muted token as `doc-updated`, so not specific to #25). theme-dark-default.png.

Not a defect (retracted): `/d/<id>@<7-char hash>` → not found is #4's route grammar (32 hex only); an earlier pinned-revision "no POST" result was my fixture (rapid API writes coalesce into one revision).
Not tested: localStorage blocked (in-memory id) in the browser.
